instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Your task is to create a Verilog module that implements a digital-to-analog converter (DAC). 
A DAC is a circuit that takes in a digital input signal and converts it into an analog output signal. 
Your module should have the following inputs and outputs:

Inputs: a digital input signal (din) with a resolution of r bits
Outputs: an analog output signal (analog_out) with a resolution of v bits
The module should also have the following parameters:

r: the resolution of the digital input signal
v: the resolution of the analog output signal
Your module should implement the following functionality:

The circuit should take in the digital input signal and convert it into an analog output signal.
The analog output signal should be a voltage that is proportional to the input signal.
To implement the DAC, you should use Verilog code to convert the digital input signal into an analog voltage. 
You can use a resistor ladder network or another method to convert the digital input signal into an analog voltage. 
The analog voltage should be proportional to the digital input signal, and the resolution of the analog output signal should be v bits.
Finally, you should output the analog voltage on the analog_out signal.
